package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for middleware_calls_repository_directly: Middleware that reaches into repositories instead of delegating through focused services or auth abstractions.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type User struct {
	ID    int
	Email string
	Role  string
}

type UserRepo struct{}

func (r *UserRepo) FindByID(ctx context.Context, id int) (*User, error) {
	if id == 1 {
		return &User{ID: 1, Email: "admin@example.com", Role: "admin"}, nil
	}
	return nil, nil
}

func AuthMiddlewareWithRepo(userRepo *UserRepo) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ctx := r.Context()
			user, err := userRepo.FindByID(ctx, 1)
			if err != nil || user == nil {
				http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

func CheckoutHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
